title: uxlfoundation/oneDNN
summary: oneDNN是一个开源的深度学习操作库，针对CPU（x64、AArch64、RISC-V）和Intel GPU进行优化，支持矩阵乘法、卷积、注意力等操作。它被PyTorch、TensorFlow、OpenVINO和ONNX Runtime等框架使用，旨在提高深度学习模型的训练和推理性能。
description: Open-source library of optimized deep learning operations (matmul, convolution, attention) for CPUs (x64, AArch64, RISC-V) and Intel GPUs. Used by PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenVINO, and ONNX Runtime.
